experimental_design.evidence: inferred: To detect perturbations in the quantitative protein profiles, we apply a Bayesian non-parametric two-sample test. First, the data are transformed using the additive log ratio transform. We then proceed to test whether the protein profiles are different between the control and treatment.

factor_value.evidence: inferred: The golgin coiled-coil proteins golgin-97 and GCC88, shown previously to capture endosome-derived vesicles at the TGN, were individually relocalised to mitochondria and the content of the subsequently re-routed vesicles was determined by organelle proteomics.

number_of_fractions.evidence: P1 pellet, 1000 × g for 20 min; P2 pellet, 3000 × g for 10 min; P3 pellet, 5000 × g for 10 min; P4 pellet, 9000 × g for 15 min; P5 pellet, 12,000 × g for 15 min; P6 pellet, 15,000 × g for 15 min; P7 pellet, 30,000 × g for 20 min; P8 pellet, 79,000 × g for 43 min; P9 pellet, 120,000 × g for 3 h. Each collected pellet was spun again under the same condition and the final pellet was frozen. The pellets were thawed the next day and both the NUC and P1 pellet were treated with 250 units of benzonase nuclease (Sigma-Aldrich, E1014) for 10 min on ice to reduce viscosity.
